briefTitle: Neoadjuvant Chemo-Immunotherapy and Surgical Resection in Locally Advanced Non-small Cell Lung Cancer With N3 Lymph Node or Other High Risk Features

typedChecks.sourceText: Creatinine clearance ≥ 45 mL/min (calculated using the Cockcroft-Gault formula). If creatinine clearance determined by Cockcroft-Gault is <45 mL/min, another appropriate validated formula or 24hr urine collection may be used in consultation with the study PI.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pathologically-confirmed contralateral mediastinal or ipsilateral supraclavicular (N3) lymph node involvement. Primary tumor and involved lymph nodes should otherwise be deemed appropriate for resection/removal with curative intent as assessed by the treating surgeon prior to study enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Complex anatomic staging subcriteria and surgeon judgment regarding resectability cannot be expressed as simple typed checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Absence of major associated pathologies and co-morbidities that elevate surgery risk to a prohibitive level, as assessed by treating surgeon prior to study enrollment.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Surgeon assessment of surgery risk is a subjective judgment.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Pulmonary function capacity capable of tolerating the lung resection proposed by the treating surgeon.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Functional capacity to tolerate surgery is an investigator/surgeon judgment rather than a single simple lab cutoff.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: EGFR, ALK, wild-type assessed via any CLIA-certified tissue testing platform. Documentation of EGFR and ALK status is not required for pure squamous NSCLC histology.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: The biomarker inclusion rules depend on histology and are structured conditionally, not as simple binary presence checks.

fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Any M1 disease.
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: M1 disease describes metastatic stage IV NSCLC, which is out of scope for stage III studies unless handled contextually; here it is listed as an exclusion.

typedChecks.sourceText: Age ≥ 18 years at time of signing the informed consent form (ICF).
Histologically or cytologically confirmed stage 3 Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC) as assessed per the 8th American Joint Committee on Cancer (AJCC) that meets one of the below criteria:
Eastern Cooperative Oncology Group (ECOG) Performance Status of 0-1.
Absolute Neutrophil count (ANC) ≥ 1.0 x 10^9/L (1000/uL) without granulocyte colony-stimulating factor support
Platelet count ≥ 100 x 10^9/L (100,000/uL) without transfusion
Hemoglobin ≥ 90 g/L (9.0 g/dL) (Patients may be transfused to meet this criterion.)
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) </= 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN)
Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) and Alanine aminotransferase (ALT) </= 3 x upper limit of normal (ULN)
Serum bilirubin </= 2.0 x ULN with the following exception: Patients with known Gilbert disease: serum bilirubin </= 3 x ULN

Any prior systemic therapy for index lung cancer, including immunotherapy, chemotherapy.
Any prior use of an immune checkpoint blockade therapy including agents directed against CTLA-4, PD-1, and PD-L1.
